profile.name: TC038烘箱温控器
profile.description: 用于 HCP TC038 实验室烘箱的温度控制与状态读取，可读取当前温度、设置温度设定值、配置监视寄存器并查询设备信息，适用于烘箱加热过程的温度调节与监测。
profile.description_en: Temperature control and status interface for the HCP TC038 laboratory oven. It can read the current temperature, set the temperature setpoint, configure monitored registers, and query device information for oven heating control and monitoring.
